plugins.author: nitansde
plugins.description: Load balance each client API key to its own codex profile and spends quota that resets soonest first — with per-key stickiness for better caches and reduce codex risk control. It also smart cherrypicks a request to kick off the weekly quota countdown. 将每个客户端 API Key 负载均衡到各自的 Codex profile，优先花最快到期的额度——每个 Key 固定绑定自己的 profile 以保持缓存热度、降低 Codex 风控；还会智能挑选一条真实请求来启动每周额度倒计时。
plugins.name: Smart Load Balancer
